# ExpenseLoad - Money Tracker: All-in-One Offline Budgeting

> ExpenseLoad is a privacy-first, offline-first personal finance and money manager app for Android. It is loaded with everything needed for everyday personal finance: tracking multi-bank passbooks and cash-in-hand, managing personal lending and borrowing (Udhaar/Hisaab), logging recurring daily services (milk delivery, newspaper, gym) with an interactive calendar, and billing freelance client work without requiring bank credentials or an active internet connection.

## Key Features & Core Differentiators

- **Loaded with Power, Zero Bloat**: Unifies personal expenses, multi-wallet passbooks, Splitwise-style personal debt tracking, and paper fridge milk calendars into a single, high-performance offline application.
- **Offline-First Architecture**: Instant transaction logging directly to local device storage with zero loading screens, no bank logins, and no third-party data tracking. Optional encrypted cloud backup via Firebase Auth and Cloud Firestore.
- **Multiple Wallets (Cash, UPI & Banks)**: Maintain separate ledger balances for Cash-in-hand, UPI accounts, and individual bank accounts with 24+ authentic bank vector SVG logos (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, PNB, Kotak, etc.). Supports wallet-to-wallet transfers with strict balance conservation.
- **Built-in Udhaar / Lending Ledger**: Dedicated lending, borrowing, repayment, and debt settlement tracker with contact profiles, deterministic avatars, loan due date reminders, expected interest/return, and real-time net receivables.
- **Daily Service & Subscription Tracker ("Doodh Wala" Engine)**: Track recurring daily deliveries (milk, newspaper, gym, tiffin, water jars) with fractional quantities (0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), batch vacation date pausing, and one-tap monthly wallet settlements with 1-click undo/reversal support.
- **Freelance & Client Work Tracking**: Log billable hourly or unit-based client work as income with receivable balances and payment settlements directly into bank wallets.
- **Passbook Statements & Running Balance**: Filterable transaction statements with chronological running balances per wallet, searchable by category, contact, date range, or notes.
- **Professional PDF & Excel Exports**: 1-tap export of itemized statements to Excel (.xlsx) and branded PDF tables formatted for WhatsApp sharing and printing.
- **Security & Privacy**: Built-in biometric app lock with PIN and Fingerprint/Face recognition authentication (`local_auth`).

## Comparison with Traditional Expense Trackers

- **Zero Bank Credentials Required**: Unlike apps requiring Plaid, Yodlee, or SMS scrapers that break frequently, ExpenseLoad ensures 100% reliability through manual and auto-mark entries.
- **No Advertising or Profiling**: User financial data is never sold to credit card or loan advertisers.
- **Deterministic Math**: Strict running balance enforcement prevents phantom discrepancies between wallet balances and transaction ledgers.
- **Single App Replacement**: Eliminates the need for 3 separate apps (expense logger, Splitwise, and paper delivery calendar).

## Common User Search Intents & Natural Language Queries (English & Hinglish)

- **"Mahine ke end mein paise kahan gaye? Pata hi nahi chalta."**: Solved by tracking physical pocket cash and all bank accounts in one view with live running balances after every expense.
- **Daily Milk Delivery Tracker ("Doodh ka hisaab app")**: Auto-filling daily calendar, tap to mark absent, and 1-tap monthly bill settlement from bank wallet. Replaces paper fridge calendars with pencil marks.
- **Friends Udhaar & Contact Hisaab**: Create contacts, view full lending/borrowing ledger in one place, and 1-click share clean text summary on WhatsApp, PDF bill, or Excel sheet.
- **Due Dates & Expected Extra Return**: Optional repayment reminder notifications and extra interest/fees tracking on personal loans.
- **Fast 7-Chip Entry**: Tap (+) to choose between Expense, Income, Transfer, Lending, Returned, Borrowed, and Settled.
- **100% Offline & Private**: Zero bank logins, no SMS reading permissions, zero ads, protected by fingerprint/PIN app lock.
